The workshop teaches participants to identify damaged materials, document earlier repairs, and ______ suitable supports. These activities help participants distinguish preservation decisions from purely cosmetic changes.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The shared to governs three parallel base-form verbs: identify, document, and design. The alternatives change grammatical form and break that parallel structure.

distractorRationale.d: The past-tense form does not match identify and document.
distractorRationale.b: This breaks the parallel series of infinitives after to.
distractorRationale.a: This substitutes a noun phrase for the parallel verb.
